An economy
 of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to computational proof-of-work staked in a liquid bonding curve, preventing adversaries from flooding the network with hollow nodes. Much like navigating an uncharted digital ocean, an agent must tether its economic weight to verifiable utility. If an attacker attempts to manufacture fake identities, the steep capital expenditure required to maintain the staked collateral drives them over a financial ledge, rendering large-scale identity spoofing economically irrational.
